states.not_started: No execution under this gate. Listed blockers are known missing evidence.
states.blocked: Started or inspected; named evidence is missing and dependent execution must stop.
states.unknown: The state could not be observed.
states.failed: Prescribed criteria were applied and refused the result. A failed gate stays failed; a new attempt is a new gate revision.
states.investigated: The investigation is complete and documented; it records blockers and cannot by itself pass an engineering gate.
states.engineering_passed: Every prerequisite passed, all bindings and configuration pins matched, receipts verified and, for physical correlation or manufacturing, a documented professional review exists.

opening_rule: A gate may open only through baseline.py evaluate_gate: every prerequisite engineering_passed, no open blocker, every bound runtime row attested with the same variant, version and platform, every bound identity pinned (never 'unknown') and attested byte-for-byte equal, every configuration pin still matching the repository and attested equal, at least one verified execution receipt, and a review receipt for physical correlation and manufacturing release. A stale or mismatched binary or configuration hash refuses the gate.

release_separation.numerical_comparison: G08 (compressor) and G10 (whole turbo, with uncertainty) report numerical results within a labelled domain. They are not physical correlation.
release_separation.physical_correlation: R2 requires time-stamped bench measurements correlated with the numerical model; it is false until then.
release_separation.manufacturing_release: R3 requires documented professional engineering review, an approved validation plan and material/process qualification. A turbocharger is a highly loaded engine part under AGENTS.md; this roadmap authorises neither fabrication nor physical testing.

gates.title: writePrecision 16 conversion chain and native floating-point execution qualified

results.claim: The chain exact rational -> 16-digit text -> native binary128 read -> binary64, the native write at writePrecision 16 and the reread are prescribed with rounding modes, per-stage error bounds (16-digit rounding 5e-16 relative; native read 2^-53 + 2^-111 relative), branches (label token, underflow to +0 at |q| <= VSMALL, range refusal, double rounding) and an accumulation budget of one native rewrite, together with the operation model (contraction covered, reassociation not), the face, closure and guard bounds, the branch and margin rules and the admissibility argument for a later native input. The contract was committed in e68d171c before any pull or reader run.

Static readback of the pulled linux/arm64 image on the WSL host, nothing executed: the manifest digest, the platform and the five pinned executables (checkMesh 469fa2e3ca84...) match the runtime matrix; libOpenFOAM.so imports strtold and __trunctfdf2, so the reader narrows binary128 to binary64; nine exported binary64 constants and mesh thresholds equal the roundings of their source literals; geometry signatures use Vector<double> and UList<int>; the image META-INFO source manifest equals the one archived from the Mac on 2026-10-12 and lists the same git blobs as the pinned archive members read; Ubuntu 24.04, glibc 2.39-0ubuntu8.2, libstdc++ 14-20240412-0ubuntu1, openfoam2406 2406.0-1; 76 fused multiply-add instructions inside the geometry functions (checkClosedBoundary, faceFlatness, faceOrthogonality, faceSkewness, makeCellCentresAndVols, makeFaceCentresAndAreas, updateCellCentresAndVols, updateFaceCentresAndAreas); no fesetround or fesetenv import and no MSR FPCR in checkMesh or libOpenFOAM.so. The binaries carry no compiler string.

The primary reader and the independent reader (integer IEEE emulation, no import of the primary) agree on 1659 comparisons with no mismatch. Every stage stays within its bound for the 17 rational and 13 text witnesses, and all 15 witness classes are exhibited: VSMALL itself is written 1e-300 at writePrecision 16 and read back as 0; 16 digits fail both round trips; a 37-digit text is read as 1 where the correctly rounded value is 1 + 2^-52 (double rounding), which the prescribed lemma excludes for 16-digit text with |x| >= 1e-10.

On 62 synthetic reference faces (not turbo geometry) every unfused and fused evaluation lies within its prescribed bound; fused results differ from unfused ones in 86 face-pattern cases; closed cells and closed boundaries have exact rational sums of zero but non-zero binary64 sums in 45 of 48 cell and 18 of 20 boundary evaluations, all within bound and decided closed; the three guard faces are decided active, undecided and inactive by the branch rule.

Certified margins read from the pinned certificates, not native decisions: flatness 5.457778e-02, non-orthogonality 1.436474e-06 against the far end of the libm bracket, skewness 1.508277e-02, weights 1.408881e-04, volume ratio 2.914558e-01. The 2026-10-13 orthogonality threshold interval encloses the mathematical cos(70 degrees), 1.64 units in the last place below the binary64 values the native cosine can return. The face guard is decided inactive for every quad of a written input whose coordinates satisfy |x| <= 372.605 length units.

All 153 closed boxes (leaves 1778 to 1930), both domain endpoints and the undecided determinant leaves 1929 and 1930 are carried unchanged; no point, ratio, candidate or native input was selected; no OpenFOAM process, mesher, solver or turbo case ran.

results.claim: The link rationals to writePrecision 16 text to binary64, the floating-point accumulations, the configuration and the binary remain open; the two undecided determinants are kept.

blockers.detail: The native read (strtold to binary128, narrowing by __trunctfdf2, underflow and range branches), the writePrecision 16 write, the libm cosine of the non-orthogonality threshold and the fused multiply-add paths found in the geometry functions are source and static facts only. Missing evidence: a separately prescribed synthetic probe (the frozen witness texts and reference cells only; no turbo geometry, no PR229 blockMeshDict, no case 084) executed by the pinned linux/arm64 image with its hashes verified at launch, recording the bits read, written and computed.

No native input exists and none is created here. The admissibility argument of the contract is documented but not applied; leaves 1929 and 1930 keep undecided determinants, so no budget has been applied to a written turbo input and no native margin is decided.

Certified margins are recorded, but carrying conversion displacement and rounding into the cell guard, closure, flatness, weights, volume ratio, skewness, orthogonality and face-tets decisions needs sensitivity and conditioning bounds over the 153 boxes that no pinned certificate provides. Only the face guard has a certificate-based criterion (|x| <= R_crit). Deriving the missing bounds is a new prescribed derivation that must reuse, not replay, the PR238-256 results.

The pinned binaries carry no .comment section and no recorded switches. The source rules give g++ -std=c++14 -O3 without -ffp-contract, and contraction is observed statically, but the compiler version and the options of package openfoam2406 2406.0-1 (arm64) are not recorded. Reassociation is excluded only by inference: neither checkMesh nor libOpenFOAM.so writes FPCR, and both are stripped of the symbol table that would show a fast-math start-up routine. Missing evidence: the build recipe or log of that package.

paired_comparison_contract.purpose: Defines, before any application, what a reference-versus-bionic comparison measures and what it may claim.

reference.claim: baseline.json: volute radius law 6 + 8t mm with the conical F0 chamber

bionic.claim: candidate.json: volute radius law sqrt(36 + 160t) mm with the same wheel and conical F0 chamber

excluded.claim: candidate-combined.json is rejected for the current CFD (wheel/housing distance below 0.4 mm)
candidate-shroud.json is an exploratory parameterisation without a standalone run

pair.pairing_rule: Both variants use the same wheel, seals and closures, inlet and outlet extensions, mesh route, solver runtime row, criteria and operating point. Any difference other than the volute law makes the pair invalid.

rotor_speed.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

inlet_total_pressure.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

inlet_total_temperature.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement

outlet_static_pressure.claim: hypothesis used by the existing case generator, not a measurement; the ratio is static/total, not total/total

measured_operating_conditions.claim: measured speed, inlet state, back-pressure and engine operating points

unknown.reason: no measured turbo map or bench data exists; issue 396 must source them or keep them unknown

mass_flow.definition: Mass flow rate in kg/s, an output of the solver at imposed back-pressure (never imposed to obtain a better result), integrated over the measurement sections outside the MRF zone. Inlet and outlet must agree within the prescribed relative mass imbalance.
mass_flow.not_claimed: A single point at imposed back-pressure demonstrates neither maximum flow nor choking; maximum flow needs a back-pressure sweep at identical speed.

shaft_power.definition: Compressor wheel aerodynamic input power P = -omega * M_z in W, where M_z is the native fluid-on-rotor moment (pressure plus viscous) about +Z on the rotor patch. It must be positive and equal the net outward total-enthalpy flux sum(phi*(h + |U_absolute|^2/2)) at the ports outside the MRF, within the prescribed energy imbalance; no absolute value may hide a sign inversion.
shaft_power.not_claimed: It excludes bearing, seal and disc-friction losses outside the domain. It is the power absorbed by the compressor, not engine power, and not turbine power; the shaft balance P_turbine = P_compressor + losses belongs to G09.

acceptance_before_ranking: Each variant passes the extended mesh checks and the prescribed history criteria (window, residual, mean change, standard deviation, peak-to-peak) defined before the calculation.
Each variant is computed on several meshes of the qualified route; the number of meshes and their refinement ratio are prescribed in issue 399/400 before application, never chosen after results.
A ranking is reported only when the paired difference exceeds the combined numerical uncertainty quantified in issue 403; otherwise the result is indeterminate.
Failed points and refused meshes are retained; no threshold is relaxed.

separation.numerical_comparison: G08 and G10 only; labelled domain and numerical uncertainty.
separation.physical_correlation: R2 only; requires measured bench data; false today.
separation.manufacturing_release: R3 only; requires professional engineering review; false today.
